tools.name: get_template_spec
tools.description: Get the editable fields of one template: current props, text roles with maxLength, theme colors, scenes, format, JSON Schema, and the source package for local rendering. Call before build_edit_link and start from the returned props.

tools.name: build_edit_link
tools.description: Validate filled-in props for a template and return a cliphou.se link that opens a live, editable preview of the customized video. The user can export the MP4 there. Invalid props return an error that names the field to fix.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_templates, render_previews · Private data: upload_logo · Public sink: upload_logo · Destructive: get_template_spec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_templates, render_previews · Private data: upload_logo · Public sink: upload_logo · Destructive: get_template_spec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
